verdict.rationale: Rainforest markets its own pre-built embeddable components, including a reporting component that plausibly covers transaction history. Its Component Studio lets platforms configure and design those components for their own integration, and the docs show deposit (payout) settings managed through the merchant API. However, no evidence describes a dedicated embedded balances or payouts view, and no evidence shows the depth of white-label branding. Missing for 10: explicit embeddable balances component, embeddable payouts/deposit history component, documented transaction-history API or report contents, detail on white-label branding controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, seller-facing surfaces are embeddable — white-label components or APIs for balances, payouts, and transaction history that live inside my product under my brand

citations.quote: pre-built, embeddable components for payments, reporting, chargebacks, merchant onboarding, and more
